categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Removes redundant accessor functions btck_chain_get_genesis and btck_chain_get_tip directly from the libbitcoinkernel C API.
categories.rationale: Trimming redundant accessor methods simplifies the public C API surface before it stabilizes. Both operations can already be accomplished using height-based lookups, making dedicated accessors unnecessary now that iterator support exists.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Excluded by the validation guide, which explicitly directs changes whose primary subject is the kernel library API to kernel rather than validation.
categories.rationale: Does not alter validation rules, block execution, or chainstate invariants; the changes are strictly limited to the kernel public API wrappers.
